attractions.name: Vin Wonders
tips: Free shuttle buses (Vin Bus 17 or 19) run to and from Phu Quoc Night Market every 10-20 mins, 6 am to midnight, about 45 mins ride

attractions.name: Phu Quoc Night Market
attractions.description: Lively evening market at 6 Bach Dang Street, Duong Dong, with more than 100 stalls for food, local specialities, souvenirs, handicrafts and pearl jewellery
tips: Best time to arrive is around 6:00 PM
Parking available around the market area
Ask before ordering savoury snacks as fish sauce and seafood ingredients are common
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc
attractions.description: Vietnam's largest semi-wildlife conservation park (380 hectares), an open-zoo with giraffes, zebras, rhinos, lions and more, plus animal shows and a tram ride through open animal zones
tips: Morning visit recommended
Shuttle buses inside the zoo area are optional and chargeable on the spot

attractions.name: VinWonders Phu Quoc
attractions.description: Vietnam's largest theme park with family rides, water park slides, 5D cinema, indoor games and street performances
tips: Large park; best enjoyed at a relaxed pace, especially with children

attractions.name: Hon Thom Cable Car
attractions.description: World's longest three-rope sea-crossing cable car, over turquoise waters, fishing villages and tiny islands to Hon Thom Island (Sun World Hon Thom)

attractions.name: Sunset Town Phu Quoc
attractions.description: Mediterranean-inspired waterfront area with stone-paved streets, colorful facades and sea views

attractions.name: Kiss Bridge
attractions.description: Bridge stretching out over the sea in Sunset Town, designed with a deliberate gap between its two ends
tips: Visit in late afternoon when the light makes the architecture and coastline more atmospheric
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Sao Beach
attractions.description: One of Phu Quoc's most recognisable beaches, with fine pale sand, turquoise water and a sheltered curved bay
attractions.entry_fee: Beach access generally free; loungers/activities may have separate charges
tips: Best visited in the morning when the light is softer and the water calmer
Parking available around the beach area
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Sun World Hon Thom Cable Car
attractions.description: Almost 8 km cable car from An Thoi over the An Thoi archipelago to Hon Thom Island, with views of islands, fishing boats and the southern coastline
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. 850,000 VND / INR 2,700 pp adult standard round-trip ticket, including access to Sun World Hon Thom and Aquatopia
tips: The cable car does not run continuously through the middle of the day
Reach the station in time for the morning operating window
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Hon Thom Island
attractions.description: Island reached by cable car with beach and sea views, walking areas, light water experiences and Aquatopia Water Park
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Sunset Town
attractions.description: Theatrical Mediterranean-style neighbourhood of pastel buildings climbing a hillside above the sea, with viewpoints, cafés and a waterfront
attractions.hours: Public area; individual attractions have their own timings
attractions.entry_fee: Free to explore; individual attractions/shows may require tickets
tips: Best explored slowly, ending at the waterfront as the afternoon light softens
Parking available in designated areas
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Symphony of the Sea
attractions.description: High-energy evening show at Sunset Town combining water stunts, jet skis, flyboards, acrobatics, music, lights and fireworks
tips: Arrive early to enjoy Sunset Town and secure a good viewing position
Taxi/Grab demand rises after the show, so allow extra time to return
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Cua Can River Kayaking / SUP
attractions.description: Calm, sheltered kayaking or SUP route in the northwest through mangroves and nipa palms; suitable for beginners and workable in the rainy season
tips: Morning is generally preferable
Allow roughly 45–60 min each way from the western resort area
Prefer sheltered river routes over open-sea paddling in September
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Snorkelling Excursion
attractions.description: Short or half-day snorkelling trip; weather-dependent
tips: Go only when the sea is calm and visibility is good
Confirm sea conditions, visibility, boat size, equipment and vegetarian lunch arrangements
Prefer a half-day or shorter excursion over a full island-hopping day
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Duong Dong Market
attractions.description: One of the island's largest traditional markets beside the river, known for local produce, dried seafood, snacks, coffee, spices and everyday goods
tips: Parking available around the market area
attractions._source_file: Vietnam/Ishita- Phu Quoc- All Inclusive Guide.docx

transport_options.description: Ride-hailing app used for airport transfers and trips between the resort area, Sao Beach, Duong Dong and Sunset Town. International Hospital Vinmec Phu Quoc is about a 3-minute drive from Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc
